tracks.name: Referral Partner
tracks.commission: 10% of first-year enterprise contract value, capped at EUR 500 per deal
tracks.payout: within 30 days of deal close by invoice
tracks.eligibility: trusted advisors with direct relationships to enterprise staffing/recruitment organizations in European or US markets

tracks.name: Brand Ambassador
tracks.commission: 20% per qualified Recruitment Pro referral; Custom-plan referral terms include flat-fee rewards
tracks.payout: within 30 days after qualifying paid conversion, by invoice
tracks.eligibility: recruiting/TA/HR-tech content creators; page states 5,000+ followers or a 1,000+ member community
